listFailed: Homebrew couldn’t list your outdated packages.
badRow: This package isn’t in the list anymore. Open the panel again.
infoFailed: Homebrew couldn’t read this package’s details.
unsupported: Only package names and --cask can run here. Run other commands in Terminal.
noNames: There’s no package name to install.
tooMany: That’s more than {max} packages. Install fewer at a time.
onlyPinned: Only pinned packages are outdated. brew upgrade leaves them as they are.
notFound.one: Homebrew has no package by that name.
notFound.some: Homebrew couldn’t find one of these packages.
busy: Another Homebrew command is running. Try again when it’s done.
needsPassword: This installer asks for your password, which works only in Terminal. Run the command there.
offline: Homebrew couldn’t download. Check your connection and try again.
installFailed: brew install stopped with exit code {code}. Run the command in Terminal to see why.
upgradeFailed: brew upgrade stopped with exit code {code}. Run it in Terminal to see why.
